items.title: Sportiello interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2020
items.q: Interviewer introduces himself as Monk Rowe; Interviewee confirms presence but does not mention any personal or professional relationship with Monk Rowe.

ctx.x: Rossano was interviewed via Zoom on July 20, 2020, by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
My name is Monk Rowe at Hamilton College for the Fillius Jazz Archive, and I’m with Rossano Sportiello today from his apartment in Manhattan is it?
That’s right. In the West Village.
